title: W11480208 — Service Diagnostics cycle entry
description: 1-2-3 key entry; press Key #2 to start service test cycle when door closes.

steps.title: Standby mode
steps.body: Dishwasher plugged in, control in standby (no cycle running).
steps.sourceExcerpt: To invoke the Service Diagnostics Mode, perform the following while in standby.

steps.title: 1-2-3 key entry + Key #2
steps.body: Press any 3 keys (except Delay, Start, Cancel) in sequence 1-2-3, 1-2-3, 1-2-3 (≤1 s between presses). All LEDs illuminate on success. Press Key #2 (Run Service Test Cycle), then close the door to start. Key #1 = UI test; Key #3 = error history (hold Key #3 5 s to clear). START/RESUME rapid-advances one interval. Door open pauses; close door to resume.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Press any 3 keys in the sequence 1-2-3, 1-2-3, 1-2-3... Then press button #2 and shut door to start the service cycle.
